summary: Maps the assigned protection command to the communication terminal's defined channel message.
description: Maps the assigned protection command to the communication terminal's defined channel message. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Protection command contacts” at the input and “Encoded channel command” at the output. Command mapping is part of the protection design.
